cohort: 621 mothers of children aged less than six months in Bure district, Amhara Region, North West, Ethiopia
finding: Home delivery, cesarean section delivery, no participation in an antenatal care group, poor knowledge of mothers about colostrum, and poor attitude of mothers towards colostrum were significantly associated with colostrum avoidance practice.
mod_finding: Home delivery and cesarean section delivery were significantly associated with colostrum avoidance practice.
